meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前,先产出一份能直接照做、决策完整的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次开工前都想先把实现方案定死、再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough idea into a decision-complete work plan before writing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the implementation plan locked down before you start coding

howto.what: 启用后 Claude 以规划顾问身份工作:先做只读探索,再产出一份决策完整的工作计划文件,不碰产品代码、不实现。只有你明确同意后才写计划,执行由单独的会话开始。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求走 ulw-plan 工作流,或要求在动手实现前先出一份计划时接管;单说 ulw 不会自动激活它。激活时首行显示 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我规划登录模块重构,先出计划
say.note: 它会先只读探索,再给你一份计划

say.text: 这是高精度规划,请按 ulw-plan 出计划
say.note: 会标记 review_required 并跑高精度审查

say.text: 我想把认证做得更好,你按 ulw-plan 规划
say.note: 意图模糊时它采用默认值,不追问

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude acts as a planning consultant: read-only exploration, then one decision-complete plan file. It never edits product code or implements; the plan is written only after you say okay, and execution starts separately.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it. Its first line reads ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan the login-module refactor first
say_en.note: It explores read-only, then hands you a plan

say_en.text: High-accuracy planning: give me a plan via ulw-plan
say_en.note: Sets review_required and runs the high-accuracy review

say_en.text: Make auth better - plan it with ulw-plan
say_en.note: Unclear intent: it adopts defaults instead of asking
